description: Second occurrence (first fixed at f7e89cc, this one at ac32a5d). Running any bn write command (e.g. `bn update <id> --notes ...`) that touches export state replaces the tracked .beads/issues.jsonl with a symlink pointing at /root/.local/share/beads-rs/exports/<store-id>/issues.jsonl, and drops a .beads/issues.jsonl.bak of the prior real-file content alongside it. Since CLAUDE.md's hard rule is that issues.jsonl is a passive export and must be a real committed file (not a symlink -- the target path is per-machine/per-daemon and would not resolve for another clone), this silently corrupts the repo state on every session that runs a bn write and then commits without checking `file .beads/issues.jsonl` first. Workaround used both times: cp the symlink target's content back over a fresh regular file, rm the .bak, then commit. Real fix belongs in kopi-beans's export path -- it should write the export in place (or write-then-atomic-rename within the same directory), never point .beads/issues.jsonl at a symlink.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content:
FIXED in 84d3f6b. Root cause was daemon/compat/export.rs ensure_symlinks(), which deliberately replaced the tracked .beads/issues.jsonl with a symlink into $XDG_DATA_HOME/beads-rs/exports/{remote_hash}/ and renamed the real file aside to .bak.

Renamed to ensure_clone_exports() and it copies now: staged beside the destination then renamed (atomic on one filesystem), a clone already holding identical bytes is skipped entirely (no mtime bump, nothing for git status), a leftover symlink from the old behaviour is replaced, and a .bak holding exactly the bytes just written is cleaned up while one that DIFFERS is kept. Old name retained as a #[deprecated] forwarder. The non-Unix branch was already a plain copy (symlinks need privileges on Windows), so this just makes every platform agree.

Upstream beads-rs still symlinks at its HEAD (39c83a3, crates/beads-daemon/src/compat/export.rs) -- checked, nothing to port, the fix is ours.

Six symlink-asserting tests rewritten to the real-file contract, plus new coverage for legacy-symlink replacement, the identical-copy no-op (asserts mtime does not move), and the .bak keep-vs-delete rule. 14 export tests + 1 export_worker test pass; clippy clean on all three touched files. Verified against a 6-run pre-change baseline that this adds no new failures (kopi-beans has 10 stable pre-existing failures + 1 flake -- see bd-ash / gh-72).

Confirmed live: a bn create after rebuilding the binary left .beads/issues.jsonl as a real file, where before it would have been re-symlinked.

title: bn export: any bd/bn write command re-symlinks .beads/issues.jsonl outside the repo
